releaseNotes:
PIXELEDU ENTERPRISE v1.0.8 ROLLOUT

CORE UPGRADES:
• LessonFlow Planner: Introduced interactive drag-and-drop scheduling, real-time PDF/Word document generation, and direct email distribution for lesson notes.
• Advanced RBAC: Expanded security overrides to safely manage emergency teacher substitutions and ad-hoc mobile submissions.

SYSTEM & SECURITY:
• Smart Vault Daemon: Implemented an intelligent, business-hours targeted automated backup engine that compresses the local SQLite database and securely emails an encrypted copy to system administrators.
• Cloud Sync Engine: Upgraded JSON extraction algorithms and integrated background ThreadPool routing for lightning-fast, freeze-free data synchronization.

Your existing database, school profile, and local configurations will be securely preserved during this update.
